hero.title: Checked at every stage, not just the last one
hero.lead: Four stages, a check at each one, and a batch code on every pouch so any pack can be traced back to its lot.

chain.title: The chain
chain.note: Every pouch can be traced back through these four steps by its batch code.
chain.c1Body: Whole spices bought from known growing regions, lot by lot.
chain.c2Body: Inspected at intake for moisture, colour, aroma and foreign matter.
chain.c3Body: Ground, weighed and heat-sealed into tamper-evident 500 g pouches.
chain.c4Body: Batch-coded, boxed and handed to the courier within 48 hours.

checks.title: What gets checked
checks.k1b: Colour and aroma against a reference sample
checks.k2a: Roast colour for each spice in a blend
checks.k3c: Batch code and dates printed and legible

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.fssaiBody: Packed under FSSAI licence [your FSSAI licence number], printed on every pack.
compliance.metrologyBody: Net quantity and MRP declared on every pack under the Packaged Commodities Rules.
compliance.complaintsBody: Quote the batch code and we trace the lot, reply within one working day, and replace anything that is not right.
